_comment: Roam level, on attack mode's symmetric sector (bd86345: its 321 wall rocks and 5 Lives, the map the same when turned 180 degrees round the centre), with 12 gold in 6 mirrored pairs. Its layout (PlayerStart, Items, Enemies markers named Gold Round / Red Round / Red Square) is edited in Assets/Scenes/Levels/level_roam.unity; the scene replaces this file's pig_start and items, and enemies listed here would spawn on top of the scene's, so keep that list empty while the scene has Enemies. gold and walking enemies on a sector twice the screen each way (35.56 x 20 world units, 4x the screen's area: x -17.78..17.78, y -10..10), the camera following the player. Enemies: gold_hook (Gold Round: walks to the nearest gold and pulls it home for the miner), hook (Red Round: walks after the player and shoots a red hook), chaser (Red Square: runs at the player and rams, close combat). Rock items are cover; wall_rocks makes them walls the enemies path round. The round is a normal one: the clock, the halfway gold goal against the miner's side (what the Gold Round banks), Lives. See LevelLoader 'Roam mode' for every param.
guide:
ROAM: the map is bigger than the screen.
The red hooks and red squares hunt you as a pack: they come from every side and cut off your way out.
